query_ground_truth.workflow_task: Manage and clean up Outlook inbox messages by finding matches from senders, subject patterns, unread status, and folder locations; move matched emails into target folders, move unwanted emails to Deleted Items, create and remove temporary rules, and cluster remaining unread emails for triage.
query_ground_truth.query: create and remove temporary outlook rules
query_ground_truth.intent: Automate email sorting or cleanup by creating temporary rules and deleting them afterwards.

request.query: create and remove temporary outlook rules

results.use_case: create and remove temporary outlook rules
results.execution_guidance: IMPORTANT: Follow the recommended plan below. Extract steps before execution, adapt to your current context, execute sequentially with current_step parameter, and check known pitfalls to avoid errors.
recommended_plan_steps: [Required] [Prerequisite]: Retrieve all message rules using OUTLOOK_LIST_EMAIL_RULES (page through results; capture each rule id plus a short conditions/actions summary).
[Optional (if rules may exist under a different mailbox/folder context)] [Prerequisite]: Confirm the correct context using OUTLOOK_LIST_MAIL_FOLDERS before selecting rule ids.
[Optional (if any id might be stale or ambiguous)] [Prerequisite]: Validate the selected rule still exists using OUTLOOK_GET_INBOX_MESSAGE_RULE (confirm the exact id to act on).
[Required] [Prerequisite]: Obtain explicit user confirmation using OUTLOOK_LIST_EMAIL_RULES details (id + summarized conditions/actions) before irreversible changes.
[Fallback (if a reversible change is preferred)] [Fallback]: Disable the selected rule(s) using OUTLOOK_UPDATE_EMAIL_RULE (set isEnabled=false) instead of deleting.
[Required] [Step]: Delete the approved rule(s) using OUTLOOK_DELETE_EMAIL_RULE (iterate per rule id and record per-rule outcome).
[Optional (for verification/audit)] [Next Step]: Re-run OUTLOOK_LIST_EMAIL_RULES to confirm the selected rule(s) are removed/disabled.
known_pitfalls: [OUTLOOK_DELETE_EMAIL_RULE] Success may return response.data as an empty object ({}); confirm via OUTLOOK_LIST_EMAIL_RULES rather than the delete payload.

[OUTLOOK_DELETE_EMAIL_RULE] Can surface embedded per-rule "ErrorMessageRuleNotFound" even when the wrapper indicates success; verify via OUTLOOK_LIST_EMAIL_RULES (or OUTLOOK_GET_INBOX_MESSAGE_RULE when available).
[OUTLOOK_LIST_EMAIL_RULES] Some broad rules may show minimal/empty conditions; review actions (and any stop-processing behavior) before deciding to delete.

[OUTLOOK_GET_INBOX_MESSAGE_RULE] Not-found or unavailability typically means the rule id is wrong/stale or the rule is from a different mailbox/folder context; fall back to OUTLOOK_LIST_EMAIL_RULES-driven selection.
[COMPOSIO_REMOTE_WORKBENCH] Previously saved remote outputs may be unavailable (file-not-found); re-fetch live rule data before executing deletes.

reference_workbench_snippets.description: List current rules and delete only those whose IDs are in a precomputed set (no reliance on saved outputs).
reference_workbench_snippets.code:
```python
res,_=run_composio_tool('OUTLOOK_LIST_EMAIL_RULES',{'top':100,'skip':0})
rules=((res or {}).get('data') or {}).get('value') or []
target_ids=set([])
for r in rules:
    rid=r.get('id')
    if rid in target_ids:
        run_composio_tool('OUTLOOK_DELETE_EMAIL_RULE',{'rule_id':rid})
```

toolkit_connection_statuses.description: Outlook is Microsoft's email and calendaring platform integrating contacts and scheduling, enabling users to manage communications and events in a unified workspace
toolkit_connection_statuses.status_message: No Active connection for toolkit=outlook. You MUST call COMPOSIO_MANAGE_CONNECTIONS (toolkit="outlook") to create a connection BEFORE executing any outlook tools.

OUTLOOK_LIST_EMAIL_RULES.description: List all email rules from inbox. No server-side filtering is supported; all rule narrowing must be done client-side after retrieval. Each rule includes a `sequence` field defining execution order and may include a `stopProcessingRules` flag affecting downstream rule execution.

top.description: Number of rules to retrieve. Default is 100. Setting this too low may return an incomplete rule set; use 100 or higher to ensure all rules are retrieved.

skip.description: Number of rules to skip before returning results. Use with 'top' for offset-based pagination.

user_id.description: The user ID or principal name (email) to list email rules for. Required for S2S (app-only) authentication. If not provided, uses the authenticated user context (/me).

OUTLOOK_DELETE_EMAIL_RULE.description: Delete an email rule permanently; deletion is irreversible. Confirm rule details with the user before executing. Removing a rule may alter the firing order and stop-processing behavior of remaining rules.

rule_id.description: ID of the email rule to delete.

user_id.description: The unique identifier of the user. Can use 'me' shortcut for /me/ path or actual user ID for /users/{user_id}/ path. Required for S2S (app-only) authentication.

OUTLOOK_LIST_MAIL_FOLDERS.description: Tool to list a user's top-level mail folders. Use when you need folders like Inbox, Drafts, Sent Ite...
